# Anne Shirley

## Overview

- **Age:** Thirteen and three-quarters (in Volume 1); later a young woman preparing for college  <sub>[v1 c30 P11](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0011)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c33 P2](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0002), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>
- **Origin:** Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia
- **Role:** Schoolteacher; future college student  <sub>[v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss Shirley; Teacher
- **Nicknames:** Anne of Green Gables; Cordelia (preferred self-name); Carrots (by Gilbert)

## Appearance

Anne is a tall, slender, and graceful young woman with red hair, grey eyes, and freckles. Her hair looks especially flattering when parted softly, giving her a Madonna-like appearance. When dressing up for special occasions, she wears frilly white organdy or pretty muslin dresses and pearl beads.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P7](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0007), [v1 c33 P8](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0008), [v1 c33 P10](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0010), [v1 c33 P11](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0011), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Personality

Anne is highly imaginative, expressive, emotional, and possesses a strong passion for nature, beauty, and literature. She is fiercely ambitious and hard-working in her academic pursuits, yet possesses a bright, cheerful spirit and a deep genius for friendship. Although prone to talkativeness, quick emotional reactions, and dramatic misadventures, she is deeply conscientious, contrite when in error, and dedicated to self-improvement.

_Sources: [v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009), [v1 c30 P13](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0013), [v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P7](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0007)_

## Traits

- Highly imaginative and romantic  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- Ambitious and hard-working  <sub>[v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003), [v1 c35 P7](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0007)</sub>
- Genius for friendship  <sub>[v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003)</sub>
- Prone to talkativeness  <sub>[v1 c30 P13](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0013)</sub>
- Sensitive about her hair and looks  <sub>[v1 c33 P10](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0010)</sub>

## Abilities

- Exceptional academic pupil in English and Literature  <sub>[v1 c35 P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005)</sub>
- Talented at recitations and public speaking  <sub>[v1 c33 P4](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0004)</sub>
- Creative writer and storyteller  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- Dedicated and sympathetic schoolteacher

## Goals

- To excel academically and earn a college degree  <sub>[v1 c30 P15](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0015), [v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003)</sub>
- To stay loyal to her friends and caretakers at Green Gables  <sub>[v1 c30 P16](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0016)</sub>
- To achieve personal growth and overcome her flaws  <sub>[v1 c30 P13](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0013)</sub>

## History

After being adopted by siblings Matthew and Marilla Cuthbert, Anne grew up at Green Gables in Avonlea, transforming her room in the east gable into a cozy sanctuary. At Avonlea School, she entered into a spirited academic rivalry with Gilbert Blythe and joined Miss Stacy's special preparation class to study for the Entrance examination to Queen's Academy. During her time at Queen's Academy, Anne worked diligently, forming close friendships with students like Stella Maynard and Priscilla Grant while competing for top academic honors. Her hard work culminated in winning the Avery Scholarship. Following her studies, she taught at the Avonlea school for two years, actively participated in local community efforts such as the Avonlea Village Improvement Society, and eventually prepared to leave for Redmond College alongside her companion Gilbert Blythe.

_Sources: [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c33 P2](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0002), [v1 c33 P4](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0004), [v1 c35 P2](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0002), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005), [v1 c35 P7](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0007)_

## Background by volume

- Orphaned in early childhood and adopted by Matthew and Marilla Cuthbert of Green Gables  <sub>[v1 c30 P16](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0016), [v1 c33 P2](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0002)</sub>
- Attended Avonlea School under Miss Stacy and joined the Queen's preparation class  <sub>[v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014)</sub>
- Attended Queen's Academy, where she won the prestigious Avery Scholarship  <sub>[v1 c35 P2](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0002), [v1 c35 P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005)</sub>

## Quotes

> I know I talk too much, but I am really trying to overcome it, and although I say far too much, yet if you only knew how many things I want to say and don’t, you’d give me some credit for it.  <sub>[v1 c30 P13](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0013)</sub>

> It’s been the dream of my life—that is, for the last six months, ever since Ruby and Jane began to talk of studying for the Entrance.  <sub>[v1 c30 P15](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0015)</sub>

> Dear Stacy, it would be perfectly dreadful if you didn’t come back. I don’t believe I could have the heart to go on with my studies at all if another teacher came here.  <sub>[v1 c30 P34](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0034)</sub>

> Do you really think the organdy will be best? I don’t think it’s as pretty as my blue-flowered muslin—and it certainly isn’t so fashionable.  <sub>[v1 c33 P7](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0007)</sub>

> Shall I put my pearl beads on? Matthew brought me a string from town last week, and I know he’d like to see them on me.  <sub>[v1 c33 P11](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0011)</sub>
